summary: Spec fidelity (atip.l0.25 Then 1: 'the CHANGELOG lists the split, moved and kept codes in one table'): the two bound tests (exit_registry atip_l0_25_the_checked_codes_hold_their_decided_exits, ..._every_split_gives_each_exit_its_own_code) read only the registry (code_info exits); neither opens CHANGELOG.md and no other test does for this table, so deleting the table (CHANGELOG.md, the 'thirteen exit-2 codes' table) leaves both green. I read the table by hand against the registry at 048a5ffa (14 rows, every Exit column agrees with code_info, decisions a/b/c match) so it is true today; it is unguarded against regression. The scenario sentence also still says thirteen while the test holds twelve (INIT_SKILL_INSTALL_FAILED left the registry in 0.35, now STOPPED_MIDWAY; the test comment says so). Blast radius: this scenario only; atip.midway.03 and old_names.rs cover the moved code elsewhere. Signed with the gap named.
